records.scope: Deliver agreed courses; capture attendance; collect learner feedback
records.out_of_scope: Employee performance decisions and production system access
records.billing_rule: 24 cohorts per annual call-off, maximum 25 learners each. Invoice at delivery; cancellation more than ten business days before delivery costs zero, later cancellation costs 25% of the cohort price.
records.format_outline: Course catalog; cohort schedule; attendance acceptance; cancellation and charges

deliverables.acceptance_test: Eight modules pass accessibility and content-owner review
24 cohorts of up to 25 learners receive scheduled sessions
Attendance and anonymized pre/post assessments delivered within five days

records.delivery_cycle: Annual work package under multi-year agreement; plan repeats only for approved subsequent scope
records.budget_basis: Annual baseline or quantity forecast, not necessarily a guaranteed fixed fee

unit_rate_card.note: Any indivisible-cent remainder is reconciled on the final annual invoice.
